drops.title: The overnight build
drops.intro: What both sessions built on the night of 26 Oct, each filmed while its automated check ran and passed in the Unity Editor.
drops.note: Not filmed here: the coast and island resort, Hollowmere's villagers, and the gulls, crabs and fish. They have no automated check with its own camera yet, so they're best seen in the game: the coast is south-east of the valley and Hollowmere just west of the yard.

clips.title: Casting gestures
clips.summary: A shove for Gust of Wind, a low-to-high raise for Raise Earth, an overhand throw for Fireball, and the arms-up pull-down for Meteor.

clips.title: Ray of Frost as a beam
clips.summary: One frost beam along the line instead of the ice sphere, freezing a path across the lake.

clips.title: Hasten Time, Control Weather, Fog Cloud
clips.summary: The day racing by, the weather stepped through rain, snow and storm, then a bank of fog, burnt through by a Fire Bolt and blown by Gust.

clips.title: Plant Growth and Spike Growth
clips.summary: A Fireball burns the meadow, Plant Growth brings the grass back and a sapling grows into a tree; then a field of thorns, walked through and set alight.

clips.title: Shapeshift
clips.summary: Aim at a deer and become one: its speed, its walk, and the herd doesn't bolt. Cast again to change back.

clips.title: Dodge roll
clips.summary: Four metres in under half a second with a full tumble, on the left trigger or Left Ctrl.

clips.title: The climbing tower
clips.summary: Moving, collapsing and phasing platforms up a 38 m column, a double jump, and fireworks at the flag.

clips.title: Tower defense
clips.summary: A wave of raiders walks the path; a Fireball takes one out, a Wall of Stone sends the rest the long way round, and one reaching the flag costs a life.

clips.title: The ball court
clips.summary: Bigger court and ball: the gate swings open as you come, a goal goes up on the board, and the ball comes back to the centre spot.

clips.title: The bigger waterfall
clips.summary: The falls at the head of the river, with solid rocks and a scree ramp up beside it.

clips.title: Currents and surf
clips.summary: The river and the surf on the new coast carry swimmers and floating things along.

clips.title: Riding the swell
clips.summary: A swimmer out at sea now rises and falls with the waves the sea draws, instead of lying on the calm level.

clips.title: Seats
clips.summary: Sit on a bench in Hollowmere, the new village west of the yard, or lie back on a lounger at the beach.
